title: encrypt.rs: AES-128 and AES-256 branches in encrypt() duplicate recipient-building loop — extract helper
description: In encrypt.rs, the two branches of the if use_aes256 block each independently build a Vec<RecipientInfo> with a for loop over recipients. The only difference is the CEK length. The duplicated loop and cek_bytes extraction could be hoisted: generate the CEK and IV based on use_aes256, then call a single shared loop. Suggested rewrite: compute (cek_bytes, iv_oct, alg) based on the flag, then call a single build-loop. This would reduce the encrypt() function by ~15 lines and make future algorithm additions touch one place instead of two.
